children: Oslo, 1 September 2026, Appear ASA (Appear, OSE: APR) today announces that Per Øyvind Stene, Chief Financial Officer, has decided to step down from his role. Stene will remain in the position until 30 November 2026.

"We are grateful to Per Øyvind for his dedication and contributions to Appear, including the preparation to and execution of the listing on Oslo Børs. We wish him every success in his next chapter,” says Thomas Bostrøm Jørgensen, CEO of Appear ASA.
The company has initiated the CFO succession process and will update the market in due course.
IR and media contact – Jo Christian Lund-Steigedal, Corporate Communications AS, +47 415 08 733 | jcs@corpcom.no

Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, Appear designs and delivers high-capacity, sustainable solutions for media processing and live content delivery. The Company's technology enables the capture, transport, and processing of live video from sports stadiums, concert arenas, and other venues to viewers with ultra-low latency, ensuring superior video quality and reliability. Appear serves broadcasters, production companies, content owners and network operators worldwide who rely on its live production technology to deliver the world's most demanding live productions.

This information is information that Appear is obliged to make public pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-01 08:55 CEST.

title: Appear ASA - CFO transition
